source: Unchanged fixed-lattice SU2 source; all-start-point Feller/cylinder martingale law,continuous bounded link drifts,fixed invariant coframes and pathwise uniqueness remain explicit upstream inputs

construction.state_kernel: Feller finite-word Borel dependence plus rational path evaluations gives x->P_x before any strong-map claim
construction.noise_kernel: One fixed global dyadic antidevelopment scheme,uniform L2 error C_T*2^-n and Borel-Cantelli define a Borel state-path noise functional valid P_x-almost surely for EVERY x
construction.coframes: Radius-two quaternion V columns=(p times e_a)/2,Theta=V^T,Theta V=I3,VV^T=I4-pp^T/4
construction.disintegration: Finite partitions of the common Wiener marginal and a Borel weak-limit/default kernel give one jointly Borel K(x,w),verified separately for every x without selecting a preparation measure
construction.compatibility: Past state kernels depend only on past noise; conditional-copy past tests preserve joint-filtration Brownianity and each marked martingale/bracket identity
construction.dirac: Pathwise uniqueness forces K(x,w) Dirac for gamma-almost every w,for every x; extract one Borel atom map F
construction.all_law_adaptedness: Separate jointly Borel past kernels at rational times,Fubini for arbitrary mu independent of W,and state-path continuity give adaptedness in each completed input filtration

reopening_conditions: Concrete analytic falsifier or failed input/constructor implication
net_update.waiting_policy: External review and unprovided continuum bridges remain nonactionable programme gates,not new waiting leaves
